messages:
nora: quick bring-up notes for nova-9b quant runs. did retrieval vs non-retrieval slices + a tiny priming experiment. posting smoke numbers and proposed routing.
ben: please paste the numbers.
nora: short table (sampled prod-like traffic):
``
variant | quant | retrieval | avgF1 | p95 latency | cost/1k tok
nova-9b-fp16 | fp16 | on  | 0.86 | 122ms | $0.050
nova-9b-int8 | int8 | on  | 0.84 | 100ms | $0.036
nova-9b-int6 | int6 | on  | 0.77 | 84ms  | $0.027
nova-9b-int6 | int6 | off | 0.81 | 82ms  | $0.027
```
nora: high level: int6 gives ~46% unit-cost reduction vs fp16 but a noticeable hit on retrieval-anchored tasks. non-retrieval tasks are much closer.
kevin: any mitigations tried? priming, postfilter?
nora: ran a 2x anchor priming and cheap token-overlap postfilter. priming recovered ~0.03 F1 on retrieval tasks; postfilter catches ~55% of major misanswers and routes them to fp16. token tax: priming ~+3 tokens -> ~$0.000081 per call on int6. fallback cost delta ~+$0.023 per 1k tokens. breakeven if priming prevents fallback > ~0.35% of calls.
ben: product will ask for thresholds. propose: int6 allowed when expected value per call <$0.007 and intent in {casual, summarization-short, format}. keep int8/fp16 pinned for billing/legal/search.
maya: ops note: int6 shows p95 jitter when batch_window_ms >= 20. recommend batch_window_ms=10 for int6, keep int8 at 16. also enable KV cache consistency checks for retrieval flows.
kevin: routing draft: default -> int8. fast-path -> int6 when (tokens_out<=64 AND retrieval_confidence<0.25 AND intent in fast_list). priming flag enabled for int6 on intents {faq, short-summarize}. postfilter threshold to escalate to fp16 on low-overlap or hallucination score>0.6.
ben: canary plan: shadow int6 at 3% for 72h, collect labeled severity and NLL deltas. gating criteria to scale: major errors <0.6% and overall regressions <6%.
nora: sample failure (sanitized) for scorecard:
``
user: who signed the NDA on behalf of vendor X?
int6: "Ricardo Vale"
fp16: "Rebecca Vale" (correct)
```
kevin: good. next actions: nora to assemble 6-sample failures + CSV of top regressed requests; ben to run 72h shadow and post interim at 48h; maya ops to adjust batch settings and add KV alignment alert.
deploy-bot: nova-9b-int6 smoke image passed at 2026-04-05T11:04:00Z.
ben: thanks all, i'll kick off the shadow and report back.
maya: i'll draft a one-page cost-vs-quality heatmap for GTN.
